name: Fairmont Beijing
insider_take: This luxury landmark sits in the diplomatic heart of Beijing, where imperial grandeur meets modern sophistication just steps from the Forbidden City.
whats_special: The Fairmont Beijing boasts one of the city's most coveted locations in the prestigious Chaoyang District, featuring stunning views of the Temple of Heaven from select rooms. The hotel's signature afternoon tea service incorporates traditional Chinese elements with French pastry techniques, creating a unique cultural fusion experience.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 15+ for spectacular sunrise views over the ancient city walls, and time your visit during autumn when the nearby hutongs are draped in golden foliage.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop terrace offers unobstructed views of Beijing's skyline transformation from ancient to ultra-modern. Take advantage of the concierge's exclusive early-morning access to the Forbidden City before the crowds arrive – it's an experience money can't usually buy.
pros: Prime location in Beijing's central business district
Multiple dining options including fine dining restaurants
cons: Large property may feel less intimate
